proposals.issue_title: Silent Image Generation Failures & Lack of Standardized Fallback Cascade
proposals.current_pain_description: Pipelines directly call individual APIs (Pollinations, Gemini, Together, etc.). If an API returns a 429, 403, or 500, the entire GitHub Actions run crashes midway, wasting computation time and leaving incomplete assets without a clean retry state.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a unified `image_generator_gateway.py` class. Implement a strict cascading fallback logic: 1. Together AI (Free Flux-Schnell) -> 2. Cloudflare Workers AI (Free) -> 3. Pollinations (Free Fallback) -> 4. Runware (Pay-As-You-Go, capped at $0.005/image). Wrap every API call in a backoff-retry loop (3 attempts) and log detailed error JSONs to Git artifacts for debugging.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates pipeline crashes, optimizes free tier usage before touching the 20€ budget, ensures 100% completion rate of runs.

proposals.issue_title: GitHub Repository Bloat & LFS Bandwidth Limits for Binary Assets
proposals.current_pain_description: Generating PDFs, high-res ZIPs, and PNGs directly inside GitHub Actions and pushing them back to the Git repo will quickly exceed GitHub's 1GB/5GB recommended repository size limit and trigger Git LFS bandwidth limits.
proposals.proposed_fix: Configure a free Cloudflare R2 bucket (10GB free storage, $0 egress fees). Update the GHA workflows to use `boto3` to upload final compiled products directly to R2, keeping only lightweight metadata JSONs in the Git repository. Delete local binary files before the GHA run completes.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Prevents repository ban/throttling, saves Hugo's mobile data when downloading assets, provides permanent direct download URLs.

proposals.issue_title: Manual Metadata & SEO Description Writing for Publishing
proposals.current_pain_description: While assets are generated automatically, Hugo must manually write titles, descriptions, tags, and category selections for KDP, Redbubble, or Cults3D on his phone, which is extremely slow and prone to poor SEO.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a mandatory final step to every production pipeline that calls Gemini 2.5 Flash to generate a `listing_metadata.json` file. This file must contain: 1. Optimized Title (under 140 chars), 2. Description (Markdown formatted, including features, dimensions, usage terms), 3. 13 Etsy tags / 7 KDP keywords, 4. Recommended price point based on competitors.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces Hugo's manual work per upload from 15 minutes to 1 minute (simple copy-paste from Termux/R2).

proposals.issue_title: Visual Quality Control Blindspot for AI-Generated Artifacts
proposals.current_pain_description: Coloring books and SVGs generated via Flux or Pollinations can contain text gibberish, broken anatomy, double borders, or gray grayscale shading instead of pure black and white line art, making them unsellable.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate `agent_gemini_quality_check` directly into the generation loop. Before saving an image, send it to Gemini 2.5 Flash (which is multimodal and free) with a strict grading prompt (e.g., 'Check if this coloring page has gray shading, overlapping lines, or text artifacts. Grade 1-10. If <8, reject'). Automate regeneration up to 3 times before giving up.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Ensures 100% of generated coloring book pages are actually of printable/sellable quality without Hugo needing to inspect each one manually.

proposals.issue_title: Lack of Multi-Format Cross-Pollination for Generated Designs
proposals.current_pain_description: When the system creates a high-quality quote or design, it only outputs it in one format (e.g., a simple graphic). It misses the opportunity to turn a single design into multiple digital products.
proposals.proposed_fix: Build a `cross_pollinate.py` utility. When a design asset is approved by the quality check, automatically spawn multiple formats: 1. PNG wrapper for Redbubble mugs/t-shirts, 2. 1:1 format for Instagram/Pinterest viral promo, 3. SVG vector package, 4. KDP interior page compilation. Store all outputs in the same R2 product folder.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Multiplies inventory volume by 4x for the exact same image generation cost and time.

proposals.current_pain_description: Because Hugo operates solely on an Android phone via Termux, he has to manually check GitHub Actions runs to see if a product is ready, check for errors, or download files, leading to friction and delayed uploads.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a free Telegram or Discord bot webhook notification inside the `agent_orchestrator`. When a GHA run finishes successfully, send a push notification to Hugo's phone containing: 1. Name of the generated product, 2. Direct download links to the PDF/ZIP on R2, 3. The generated SEO copy text for easy mobile copying, 4. A low-res preview image.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Transforms a clumsy mobile workflow into a seamless push-button publishing experience directly from the phone's notification shade.
